analysis.title: One River Peters - wknd notes - 22 Nov 2026
key_insights: Fed minutes from the Oct 27-28 meeting show almost all participants judged further rate hikes would likely be appropriate. Waller pressed for 50bps in December, and Goolsbee and Cook also sounded hawkish.
Friday's S&P 500 close was 10.8% below its Oct 28 level and the Nasdaq 100 was 16% lower. S&P and Dow entered correction and the Nasdaq Composite erased its 2026 gains.
S&P 500 fell 8.6% on the week. VIX rose 16.59 to 35.89, touching 40 intraday, the highest since April 2025.
Nvidia fell 13.8% Friday after Reuters reported its accounting is a focus of an SEC probe. It lost 23% on the week despite a blowout earnings report Tuesday evening.
Anthropic priced its IPO at $83, above the expected range, and closed 17% higher on debut Thursday, then fell 8.5% Friday as concern grew that the AI trade is unraveling.

Interviewee Sparks argues AI creates uncontainable existential and cyber risk because it can find every weakness in legal, financial and software systems. He expects the next 1-3 years to bring hysteria, chaos and disruption.

Sparks says stocks are 40-50% too high on fundamentals, with earnings 30% above the 50-year trend line, and the market is levered to the AI trade. His recommended holding is Treasuries in the 3 to 5 year range.
Cross-asset weekly moves were large: Bitcoin -15.2%, Ethereum -17.8%, Gold -9.5%, Silver -16.4%, Copper -9.9%, Nikkei -7.7%, Euro Stoxx -5.8%. USD rose against most EM currencies.
Treasuries rallied on the week. 2yr yield fell 20bps to 4.65% and 10yr fell 19bps to 4.95%. Breakevens fell in the US, EU, Japan and UK.
Data released this week: US industrial production -0.4% MoM vs 0.1% est, jobless claims 203k vs 198k est, Eurozone CPI 4.0% as expected with core 2.6% vs 2.5% est.

market_movers.rationale: Stock fell 13.8% Friday on a reported SEC probe into its accounting and 23% on the week, despite a raised sales forecast.

earnings_insights: Nvidia reported a blowout earnings report Tuesday evening and boosted its sales forecast, lifting the stock after hours. It then lost 23% on the week.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Weak activity miss alongside a hawkish Fed.

crypto_views: Bitcoin fell 15.2% and Ethereum fell 17.8% on the week as risk assets sold off.

trade_ideas.description: Long Treasuries in the 3 to 5 year maturity range, as recommended by interviewee Sparks
trade_ideas.rationale: Sparks expects a severe equity bear market and calls Treasuries not sexy but the thing to own.

risk_factors: Fed tightening, with a possible 50bps hike in December and risk of falling behind the curve.
SEC civil probe into Nvidia's disclosures and accounting.
AI trade unraveling, with the market heavily levered to it.
Societal conflict over whether to shut off AI and data center moratorium fights.
Cybersecurity vulnerability from AI that can find every system weakness.
Crowded positioning and forced stop-loss cascades.
vol_and_positioning: VIX briefly touched 40, the highest since April 2025, and closed near 36 at 35.89, up 16.59 on the week.
Leveraged Nvidia longs were flushed after a post-earnings pop reversed. The author describes herd positioning being culled in violent flushes.
The author cites February 2018, when inverse VIX products lost 96% in an afternoon, as a precedent for crowded positioning unwinds.
geopolitical: Trump, Xi and Putin held a first-ever trilateral meeting discussing UN reform, oil supply and nuclear risk, with nothing on Ukraine or Iran.
Iran targeted a Bahrain base but said the path to a US deal is open.
The US moved to further restrict access to advanced chips.
